root_cause.text: The cp2615 driver dereferences the USB device serial string pointer (usbdev->serial) without checking for NULL, causing a NULL-pointer dereference when the device has no serial number.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a guard `if (!usbdev->serial) return -EINVAL;` before calling `strscpy(adap->name, usbdev->serial, ...)`, and the commit message explicitly states that the driver "does not make sure that the string exists" and that the fix avoids "triggering a NULL-pointer dereference".
